assertion_analysis.100: Removing callback registration, failure storage, failure augmentation or changed-report refresh leaves zero matching duty rows; the base negative control records 0 == 1 for follower_live=True.
assertion_analysis.101: Dropping or replacing the real promotion exception in the duty detail fails against the independently declared ERROR literal.
assertion_analysis.102: Omitting the summary recomputation after appending a duty leaves the stub count at zero and fails.
assertion_analysis.104: Non-independent ownership check: the payload_for stub supplies the constant SESSION regardless of its argument; see the non-blocking finding.
assertion_analysis.110: Treating a whole-pass error as a completed clean pass removes the earlier duty and fails the comparison with the prior published row list.
assertion_analysis.121: Leaving the promotion failure active or reporting it after the successful sweep fails the empty failure-list assertion.
assertion_analysis.124-127: Retaining a stale failed-run duty or stale count in a readable cleared answer fails; deleting the answer altogether bypasses these assertions, as recorded in the second non-blocking finding.
assertion_analysis.95,109,120: Each request assertion fails if SweepBeat stops accepting an idle changed session; synchronous execution ensures the following assertions see completed work.
assertion_analysis.96: The real resumption.sweep must report the injected promotion exception with the fixture run ID and independently stated exception type/message; swallowing or misattributing it makes this fail.
assertion_analysis.98: Removing the callback or publication for an absent follower makes the answer null; the base negative control fails here for follower_live=False.

findings.text: non-blocking: the session assertion compares the exported value with SESSION after the payload_for stub at lines 68-76 unconditionally supplied that same SESSION, so it cannot detect refresh passing the wrong session to the derivation; make the stub report its session argument and independently assert the owner it received.

non-blocking: the clearing assertions are conditional on cleared being non-null even for follower_live=True, so a regression that removes the entire live-session answer after success passes this portion of the test; require a readable cleared answer in the live-follower case before checking its rows and count.
